name: Red Dragon Guppy (Pair)
description: The Red Dragon Guppy is renowned for its intense red delta tail and sparkling dragon scale patterning. Active, healthy, and accustomed to clean planted aquarium environments. Carefully acclimatized and conditioned.
shortDescription: Mesmerizing crimson dorsal and caudal fin with silver mosaic scales.

name: Albino Full Red Guppy (Pair)
description: The Albino Full Red (AFR) is one of the most celebrated show-grade strains worldwide. Solid crimson red pigmentation from nose to tail tip with striking authentic red albino eyes.
shortDescription: Pure ruby-red eyes with vibrant solid carmine body and flowing fins.
color: Solid Carmine Red with Ruby Eyes

name: Black Tuxedo Guppy (Pair)
description: Known as the gentleman of the aquarium, the Black Tuxedo displays a deep solid ebony coat covering the rear two-thirds of the torso with contrasting pearl front scales.
shortDescription: Elegant velvety jet-black half-body contrasting with pale pearl highlights.

name: Galaxy Blue Grass Guppy (Pair)
description: A masterpiece strain bred for exquisite fine grass dots scattered uniformly across wide fan caudal and high dorsal fins. Radiant metallic sheen in planted displays.
shortDescription: Intricate star-dusted fine mosaic pattern across translucent cyan fins.

shortDescription: Snow-white pearlescent body reflecting pure silver under aquarium illumination.

name: Dumbo Ear Red Tail Guppy (Pair)
description: Features oversized pectoral fins that flutter gracefully like wings, paired with brilliant scarlet tails. One of the most charismatic and sought-after show strains.

name: AquaGrowth Pro Guppy Micro Pellets (50g)
description: Specially engineered for the small upturned mouths of guppies. These micro-granules float momentarily before gently sinking, catering to all water levels without clouding water.
shortDescription: Slow-sinking 0.4mm micro pellets enriched with spirulina and krill meal.
feedingDirections: Feed small pinches 2-3 times daily what fish can consume within 2 minutes. Does not cloud water.

name: AquaGrowth Pro Guppy Micro Pellets (100g Jumbo)
description: Double the volume for dedicated breeders and community aquarium keepers. Provides balanced immune support, rich astaxanthin for color pop, and high digestibility.
shortDescription: Value 100g pack of our best-selling high-protein slow-sinking micro pellets.
feedingDirections: Feed 2-3 times daily in portions consumed within 90-120 seconds.

name: VibrantColor Tropical Spirulina Flakes (45g)
description: Crafted with premium plant greens and aquatic proteins. Crumbles easily between fingertips for newborn fry and adult guppies alike. Enhances natural blues and reds noticeably within 2 weeks.
shortDescription: Ultra-thin crispy surface flakes with 12% natural spirulina for color enhancement.
feedingDirections: Crush gently with fingertips for young fry or float whole for adult display pairs.

name: Freeze-Dried Artemia Baby Brine Cubes (30g)
description: The ultimate high-protein conditioning treat for conditioning breeding pairs and powering juvenile growth. Free of parasites and pathogens associated with live feeder cultures.
shortDescription: 100% natural nutritious brine shrimp cubes freeze-dried to lock in live food vitality.
feedingDirections: Press cube against inside aquarium glass or crumble into water column as a treat 3-4 times weekly.
